in_sanskrit.name: Gobi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Hill, Mountain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gobi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, the name Gobi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Govind' meaning 'God'. The name Gobi signifies a person connected to the divine and holds a strong spiritual connection with the mountains and nature.

in_tamil.long_meaning: Hillock (of Kobis or Kottais) | Jolai (of Kobis or Kottais)
